_comment: The fine-tune recipe, committed rather than passed in the environment.
It lived in JEV_EPOCHS for one run, and regenerating the notebook without that variable set
silently reset the run to 4 epochs - the same one-fact-in-two-places failure this project keeps
meeting. A committed file cannot be forgotten at the shell.
train_ddp.py still reads the environment; the notebook exports these values, so this file is the
8 epochs matched the v4 run, so the epoch count is not a confound when comparing them.
